How to read this page (tap to expand)

What this page is

Best Picks is the research hub — it blends every other screener (APEX, Breakout2, Creamy, Multibagger, IR, Rocket) plus engineered features into one self-learning Master Score and a calibrated Win Probability. It is not the buy-trigger page — for the actionable, timing-checked entry list use Triggers.

Master Score & Win Prob

Master (0-100) is a regime- and macro-weighted blend across 5 factor blocks: Momentum, Technical, Quality, Value, Conviction.

Win Prob is a calibrated probability of beating the Nifty over ~20 trading days, fitted by isotonic regression on this page's own realised outcomes, using one row per ticker-episode so overlapping windows cannot inflate confidence.

Tabs

Best Overall top 150 by Win Prob. Actionable only stocks with a real trade plan (entry/stop/target). Swing/Positional/Long-term re-rank by the Win Prob computed for that specific holding horizon. Low-risk restricts to low-ATR (≤4%) names.

Trade Plan column

✅ Breakout plan = precise entry/stop/exit from a Breakout2 pivot + ATR. 📊 Positional plan = no chart pivot, so the stop is an ATR- or 8%-estimate — trade smaller. ⏳ Near pivot = wait for the breakout before entering. Prices refresh live during market hours.
